comment: The chapter emphasises structured and governed data but does not mention model interoperability, standardised output representation, model metadata, provenance, or integration of AI-generated results into EHR workflows.

public.text: The chapter emphasises structured and governed data but does not mention model interoperability, standardised output representation, model metadata, provenance, or integration of AI-generated results into EHR workflows.
public.suggestedRevision: Add requirements for standardised model inputs and outputs, provenance, confidence or uncertainty representation, workflow integration, version identification, and traceability of AI-supported recommendations.
